title: Update GitHub Actions workflow permissions and token
diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/sync-with-source.yml b/.github/workflows/sync-with-source.yml
index c37ae25..0868cc1 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/sync-with-source.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/sync-with-source.yml
@@ -8,6 +8,7 @@ on:
 permissions: 
   contents: write
   pull-requests: write
+  repository-projects: write
 
 jobs:
   sync:
@@ -24,7 +25,7 @@ jobs:
           git push origin sync/upstream --force
       - name: Update PR
         env:
-          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SYNC_DEMO1 }}
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
         run: |
           gh pr create --base main --head sync/upstream \
             --title "Sync from upstream" \
